name: oak
$comment: FFmpeg for the Linux/macOS CI/CD builds with the project's feature set (every free codec + hwaccel, mirroring tooling/ffmpeg/build-ffmpeg.sh's configure switches); Windows uses the vendored BtbN prebuilt instead (GPL shared, MSVC import libs) because a cold vcpkg FFmpeg build there took ~40 minutes — see the ffmpeg-prebuilt-win64-n8.1 release. pkgconf is needed everywhere (oak-ffmpeg-link's build script). Local builds may keep using tooling/install-deps.sh + tooling/ffmpeg/build-ffmpeg.sh. ffmpeg is pinned to 8.1.2#3 via overrides (matching the ffmpeg-next 8.x binding); builtin-baseline pins the rest of the port tree.
